title: My itch.io stats after 5 days of publishing a game made fully with AI, what do you think?
author: Scorchyy
selftext: You can play it here if you want: [https://ammoniastudios.itch.io/neon-swarm](https://ammoniastudios.itch.io/neon-swarm)

comments.author: shaymagen
comments.body: Neon Swarm looks fun and it's cool that it runs right in the browser. If you want another spot for people to find it, I run vibe1up.com, a free showcase of AI-made browser games, and you can drop it in here: https://vibe1up.com/submit/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=comment&utm\_campaign=aigamedev. We check every link daily, and dead games get hidden and kept as archived pages with a Wayback Machine copy, so everything listed actually plays.

replies.author: shaymagen
replies.body: Can you provide me with the vibe1up link you see your game at? I cant find it.

replies.author: Scorchyy
replies.body: I'll pass, can't post it on every platform
